description: This file defines a SplashActivity class for an Android TV app, serving as an introductory splash screen that displays for 3 seconds before navigating to MainActivity. It uses FragmentActivity to ensure compatibility with TV-specific features and includes lifecycle management to handle handler callbacks safely.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: A minimal splash screen activity for Android TV that displays a centered 'Streamly' text and transitions to MainActivity after 3 seconds.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and schedules navigation to MainActivity after a delay.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes pending callback to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
